ready_valid_dependency_audit.static_reason: group_capacity depends on reset, sticky fault, fill state and output elasticity; group_ready gates semantic validity only when group_valid=1. Neither descriptor_audit nor request_audit consumes group_ready or group_accept.
ready_valid_dependency_audit.integration_rule: The external producer must still obey the standard rule that valid and payload do not depend combinationally on ready, or use a registered/skid boundary.

tagged_completion_audit.definition: done_valid equals accepted update_last in the same cycle; done_block and done_row equal the accepted update identity
tagged_completion_audit.safe_completion_identity: done_valid, done_block, and done_row may be consumed together even while a different next-row descriptor is accepted

exploratory_full_dc_3ns.safe_use: This establishes that the M131 logic-only design completes synthesis and meets the 3 ns exploratory constraint. It does not establish a frequency improvement, macro-inclusive PPA, or physical speedup.

m128_same_context_exploratory_dc_compari.safe_use: At the same fixed 3 ns exploratory zero-macro logic-only context, M131 costs 0.4733% more cell area than M128 and has 0.3346 ns more setup slack; both meet setup and hold. This is not a maximum-frequency ratio, power comparison, macro-inclusive PPA, or physical speedup.

descriptor_and_row_claim_boundary.payload_arithmetic: block3 + row9 + count_minus_one2 + source_ids16 + negate4 + last1
descriptor_and_row_claim_boundary.counterexample: Three legal strictly increasing descriptors for one row skipped source IDs and were accepted; monotonic nonoverlap prevents duplicate/backtracking work but does not prove that every required source appears exactly once.

P1.title: Stream-local monotonicity does not close complete row partition losslessness
P1.evidence: M131 rejects duplicate and backtracking sources across descriptors, but it has no expected-row source set or end-of-row coverage ledger. The independent positive test accepted three strictly increasing descriptors with omitted source IDs. The external 35-bit descriptor producer is not implemented.
P1.required_fix: Implement and exact-SHA verify the descriptor producer with a row-level exactly-once/losslessness proof, or retain a trusted-input stream-local claim and never equate monotonic ordering with complete row correctness.

P2.title: 35 bits is descriptor payload, not complete interface or traffic cost
P2.finding: The 35-bit arithmetic excludes ready/valid, the derived 16-bit mask, framing, queues, producer state and descriptor transport. No matched bandwidth ledger exists.
P2.required_fix: Use descriptor_payload_bits=35 and keep bandwidth/cost claims false until the producer and full traffic format are modeled.

P2.title: The completed 3 ns DC run is exploratory rather than exact-SHA launch sealed or matched to M130
P2.finding: The run completed and met setup/hold, but it has no launch manifest or sealed receipt and M130 has no valid DC result for comparison. A same-context exploratory M128 comparison shows M131 is 0.4733% larger with 0.3346 ns more setup slack at fixed 3 ns, but neither run is a frequency sweep or exact-SHA launch seal.
P2.required_fix: Seal a matched source/tool/constraint launch and compare against a valid baseline across a frequency grid before admitting frequency or physical speedup.

P2.title: The reported 89,467 um2 is logic-only with zero macros
P2.finding: The cache synthesizes as standard-cell multi-read logic under ideal clock and ZeroWireload; Macro Count is zero. The number is not macro-inclusive area, routed timing, or power.
P2.required_fix: Use a realizable banked SRAM/register-file boundary plus macro timing/energy and post-layout evidence before citing physical PPA.

P2.title: Independent precompile check_design is not warning-free
P2.finding: Analyze/elaborate/check_design returns true and has no ELAB-312, but reports 386 LINT-1 undriven elaboration cells and 780 LINT-31 shorted sign-extension outputs. The exploratory postcompile check_design report is warning-free after optimization.
P2.required_fix: Describe the result specifically as negative-index/elaboration repair. Audit or waive the LINT classes before claiming a zero-warning RTL design.

paper_safe_statement: Exact-SHA Synopsys VCS plus an independent adversarial VCS test verify M131 descriptor-local signed K1-K4 arithmetic, strict within- and cross-descriptor source ordering, payload-independent idle ready, 73-cycle backpressure, reset isolation, 95 consecutive cross-row descriptor/update II1 intervals, and 100 tagged-done overlaps with correct prior-row identity. Independent Synopsys DC analyze/elaborate/check_design confirms that M130's predecessor negative index is absent. A separate exploratory TSMC28 logic-only DC run completes at 3 ns with 0.6733 ns worst setup slack, 0.0001 ns worst hold slack, 89,467.06 um2 cell area, and zero macros. Complete row partition losslessness, the descriptor producer, matched frequency improvement, macro PPA, physical speedup, system speedup and headline claims remain unadmitted.
prohibited_claims: Do not call stream-local monotonic ordering complete row losslessness.
Do not describe the external descriptor producer as implemented or free.
Do not call 35 payload bits the complete interface, buffering, or bandwidth cost.
Do not call the exploratory 3 ns run an exact-SHA sealed matched comparison or maximum-frequency result.
Do not call the zero-macro logic-only area macro-inclusive PPA.
Do not claim frequency, physical, system, energy, FPS, best-paper, or headline speedup from M131 evidence.
